name: cry_wailord_doubles

name: cry_bulbasaur_encounter

name: cry_second_bulbasaur_pidgey

name: cry_over_se

name: cry_over_bgm
note: a cry over music: mus_littleroot on BGM (10 tracks), then StartCry of Cry_Bulbasaur (gCryTable[0]) at the defaults on VBlank 60 (start tick on frame 62) -- cry player 0 chained after BGM (engine tracks 10..11); all five DirectSound channels are ON on frame 62, so ply_note's stopping-candidate rule steals channel 1, a releasing note of BGM track 1, and unlinks it from the BGM's chain at once (the measured 70 = NOTE_UNLINK_11 66 + CHAIN_EMPTY 4; the BGM's tick frames then read -32 for the missing channel); the cry dies through the count path on frame 108; kept at 3 s so the existing 180-frame probe covers the row -- the cry's EOT on frame 202 is past it (its chain is empty by then, so only the tick's xWAIT would be covered by 4 s); the probe log build/probe/cry_over_bgm.txt, 180 frames
